_meta.note: Discrete-GPU VRAM. Unified-memory devices (Apple Silicon, iGPU) use the smaller 'uma' figure and share the budget with the OS.
_meta.known_gaps: gemma-4-e2b-it Q4_K_M failed to parse on the collection run and is omitted.
_meta.naming: Model ids are the HuggingFace repo name minus the -GGUF suffix, lowercased.
_meta.schema: quants = VRAM of each quant at reference_ctx_size with q8_0 KV cache. ref_curves[kv][ctx] = VRAM of ref_quant at that context and KV cache type. Weight quant and KV type are independent, so VRAM(q, ctx, kv) = ref_curves[kv][ctx] + quants[q] - quants[ref_quant].
